sources: https://docs-v1.paystack.com/docs/events — "Structure of an event object" (the full invoice.update payload, incl. the invoice period, paid flag, subscription and transaction sub-objects)

https://paystack.com/docs/payments/subscriptions/ — "Listen for subscription events": "An invoice.update event will be sent after the charge attempt. This will contain the final status of the invoice for this subscription payment, as well as information on the charge if it was successful", and "Invoice Updated" in the event examples
https://paystack.com/docs/payments/webhooks/ — "Types of events": invoice.update — "An invoice has been updated ... You should inspect the invoice object returned and take necessary action"
provenance.adaptedValues: Field names, nesting and types are exactly as published; values adapted to the sandbox GHS flow. The published invoice.update example carries NO email_token on its subscription object — preserved here, because the normalizer never reads an email_token in any event (it is the provider's cancellation credential).
provenance.mappingNote: The provider documents invoice.update as carrying the FINAL status of the invoice and instructs the integrator to inspect the invoice object, so the canonical type follows the documented boolean data.paid: true → invoice.processed, false → invoice.failed. This is an invoice outcome, never a payment confirmation.
